name: Flashlight
description: Wits +1: sees what others miss.

name: Reinforced backpack
description: Brings back 25% more loot.

name: First-aid kit
description: The first injury is one level less severe. Used up.

name: Padded vest
description: Endurance +2.

name: Portable radio
description: The wearer's signal comes through cleaner: less noise and fewer lost hints.

name: Helmet
description: Endurance +1: takes a knock so the head doesn't.

name: Lucky charm
description: Nerve +1. It's probably nothing. Probably.

name: Soft boots
description: Stealth +1 and expeditions 10% shorter.

name: Tool belt
description: Craft +1: the right tool, always at hand.

name: Work gloves
description: Craft +1: grip on anything, cuts on nothing.

name: Headlamp
description: Hands free, eyes open.

name: Gas mask
description: Smoke, spores, the smell of the dead.

name: Binoculars
description: See it before it sees you.

name: Compass
description: North is still north. Less wandering.

name: Leather jacket
description: Old, heavy, honest.

name: Rain poncho
description: Dry is half of sane.

name: Running shoes
description: Light and fast, until they aren't.

name: Steel-toe boots
description: Heavy. Nothing gets through.

name: Messenger bag
description: Quick in, quick out.

name: Hiking pack
description: Room for everything. Feels like it, too.

name: Multitool
description: Pliers, blade, screwdriver, a bottle opener for morale.

name: Canteen
description: Water, and the habit of stopping to drink it.

name: Crowbar
description: Doors are suggestions.

name: Bicycle
description: Trips 25% shorter for one. No fuel, just legs. Everyone on the team needs a seat for it to count.

name: Motorbike
description: Two on it, trips half as long. Burns 1 fuel an hour on the road.

name: Pickup truck
description: Three in the cab, trips 40% shorter, and the bed brings home 40% more. Burns 2 fuel an hour.

name: Road bike
description: Rebuilt from three finds. Light, fast, no fuel: trips 40% shorter for one.

name: Sidecar motorbike
description: A motorbike with a sidecar, pieced together from the far bands. Three aboard, trips 45% shorter, room for 20% more. Burns 1.5 fuel an hour.
